detail: `render_view` 產出的 APP 表（`APP_COLUMNS` 11 欄，:869-881）永遠 import 不回來。`_anchors_ok`（:491-506）在 cells[3]/[4]/[5] 找 category/severity/status，而 APP 列該三格是 surface/category/severity，不匹配就落進 `malformed-row`。實測並由主線複驗：一筆 APP entry 的 store，`render` 後 `import` 得到 malformed-row（columns 11, expected 8）、imported 0、rc=2。docstring（:526-533）宣稱 APP-* rows are skipped rather than reported 是**假陳述**——那個 skip 分支（:560-561）排在 `_anchors_ok` 之後，對本模組自己 render 出來的 APP 列永遠到不了，是死碼，只有假想的 8 欄 APP 列才會觸發。`_cmd_import`（:1188）把 malformed-row 判為 lost 並回 rc=2，其註解自己寫著 those are entries that would vanish——正是這裡發生的事。今天 `import` rc=0 純粹因為 store 裡零筆 APP；第一筆 APP entry 一旦 render 進 view，這條被文檔化的指令就永久轉紅，且錯誤訊息會誣指是列格式壞掉。**連坐**：IMP-20260805-355016 的整個取捨前提是「產出的 view 仍可被 importer 讀回等於遷移可逆」，本次實測證明該性質對 APP 半邊早已不成立。測試面的縫：`ops/tests/test_backlog_migration.py:343-366` 的 render 測試只斷言排序，沒有再 import 回去。
plan:
1. REPRODUCE FIRST, no source edit. In a scratch dir: ops/backlog.py add --store s --stream APP --date 2026-08-05 --source dogfood --category ux --severity high --status open --detail x --surface reader --repro y ; then ops/backlog.py render --store s --out view.md --commit ; then ops/backlog.py import --store s2 --from view.md --commit. Measured 2026-08-05: malformed-row (columns 11, expected 8), the APP row is not imported, rc=2. The IMP row on the same view imports fine.

2. TEST FIRST (tie-law 1). In ops/tests/test_backlog_migration.py, right after test_app_entries_render_in_their_own_section (ends line 367), add test_app_rows_survive_render_then_import: build a tmp store with import_legacy of one IMP row plus add_entry(stream=APP, category=ux, severity=high, status=open, surface=reader, repro=...); rendered = render_view(store, verified_against=deadbeef); _, problems = parse_legacy_table(rendered); assert no problem has kind malformed-row; write rendered to a file and assert BACKLOG.main([import, --store, str(tmp/s2), --from, str(f), --commit]) == 0. Run the acceptance command: RED today, kind malformed-row.

3. THE FIX. ops/backlog.py parse_legacy_table, lines 602-619. Order today is: looks_like_id = bool(_ID_RE.match(cells[0])) ; then if not _anchors_ok(cells): report malformed-row and continue ; then if cells[0].startswith(APP-): continue. Move the APP branch ABOVE the _anchors_ok gate, directly after the looks_like_id assignment, and make it report instead of returning silently:
    if cells[0].startswith("APP-"):
        problems.append({"kind": "app-row-skipped", "id": cells[0], "line": lineno, "columns": len(cells), "note": "render emits APP rows with APP_COLUMNS (11 wide); the 8-column legacy parser deliberately does not read them back"})
        continue
Why the order IS the bug: an APP row carries surface/category/severity in cells[3][4][5], so _anchors_ok (549-564) can never line up on it, so every APP row fell into the malformed-row branch at 606-616, which _cmd_import line 1278 counts as lost and turns into rc=2. The existing skip at 618-619 was dead code for every row this module renders itself.

4. Do NOT add app-row-skipped to the lost kinds at ops/backlog.py:1278. Advisory means rc stays 0; that is what makes step 2 green.

5. Fix the false docstring at ops/backlog.py:586-588. It claims APP-* rows are skipped rather than reported and that an APP row can only come from a table with a different column set. The first half was untrue (they were reported, as lost). Replace with: APP-* rows are skipped BEFORE the anchor check and the skip is reported as app-row-skipped (advisory, not lost), because the generated view renders them 11 columns wide, so the 8-column anchors can never line up and the legacy parser does not read them back at all.

6. Update the three real-ledger tests that silently assume the shipped view has zero APP rows. They are green today only because the store has zero APP entries and they turn red the day the first one is filed: test_backlog_migration.py:517-519 (loop asserting every problem kind == recovered-row) must accept recovered-row or app-row-skipped; :531-532 in test_generated_view_needs_no_recovery, replace assert problems == [] with an assertion that no problem kind is malformed-row or recovered-row; :546 in test_real_ledger_survives_a_full_round_trip, same relaxation (its dict comparison already covers IMP rows only, because parse_legacy_table now returns no rows for APP).

7. Correct the comment at ops/backlog.py:928-932, which claims the generated view can still be read back by the importer so the migration is reversible. Measured today that is false twice over: APP rows are not read back at all (this entry), and GROOM_FIELDS (plan / acceptance / groomed_at / groomed_by) appear nowhere in the view. Narrow it to: the IMP table stays at 8 columns so the importer can read those 8 fields back; the view is not a lossless mirror of the store.

8. SAME BREATH, MANDATORY, otherwise the acceptance is a booby trap. ops/backlog.py:804-806 carries only VERDICT_FIELDS forward from the entry already on disk, so ops/backlog.py import --commit against the real store ERASES every groom stamp. Measured 2026-08-05 in a scratch store: plan / acceptance / groomed_at / groomed_by all present before, all four gone after one import of the view render, rc=0, no report. Fix: iterate VERDICT_FIELDS + GROOM_FIELDS at line 804, and add a keyword-only groom_fields param to add_entry mirroring the verdict_fields whitelist at 331-335 (additive, so no existing caller breaks). Add a test beside test_import_does_not_delete_entries_absent_from_the_table (line 239): groom an entry, render, import, assert the four groom fields survive unchanged.

9. Never run ops/backlog.py import --commit against the default store to check acceptance. The pytest run covers it entirely with temp stores.
resolution: —(2026-08-05 驗證 CONFIRMED-OPEN；落點 `ops/backlog.py:491-506` 與 `:560-561`，成本 M。兩條路：把 APP skip 提到 anchors 檢查之前（便宜，但等於正式承認 APP 半邊不可逆），或讓 importer 認得寬表（貴，但回復 IMP-20260805-355016 賴以成立的性質）。驗收：`add --stream APP` → `render` → `import` 必須 rc=0 且零 malformed-row；並在 `test_backlog_migration.py:343-366` 補一條 render 後 re-import 的往返斷言，那條縫就是本 bug 躲過測試的地方。)
